mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId} AND (R.ROLE_CD = 'SUPER' OR (R.ROLE_CD <> 'CARD' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_ROLE_MENU_R RM WHERE RM.ROLE_SQ = R.ROLE_SQ AND RM.MENU_CODE = 'K00001')))

SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, DEPT_NM, EMPLY_ID, STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STATUS_CD <> 'LEFT' OR STAFF_SQ IN (SELECT STAFF_SQ FROM TB_EEP_CARD_M WHERE STAFF_SQ IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY STAFF_NM
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R (EMPLY_ID, ROLE_SQ, REG_EMPLY_ID) SELECT #{EMPLY_ID}, ROLE_SQ, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID} FROM TB_EEP_ROLE_M WHERE ROLE_CD = 'CARD'
mapper.select: SELECT D.COMN_DTL_CD AS CD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_NM AS NM FROM TB_EEP_COMN_CD_M C JOIN TB_EEP_COMN_DTL_CD_S D ON D.COMN_CD_SQ = C.COMN_CD_SQ WHERE C.COMN_CD = 'CARD_USE' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD IS NULL, D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CARD_M (CARD_NM, CARD_CO, LAST4, HOLDER_NM, STAFF_SQ, USE_YN, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{CARD_NM}, NULLIF(#{CARD_CO}, ''), #{LAST4}, #{HOLDER_NM}, #{STAFF_SQ}, #{USE_YN}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT USE_SQ, CARD_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(USE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS USE_DT, AMT, USE_CD, DETAIL, MERCHANT, TARGET_NM, DATE_FORMAT(CLOSE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CLOSE_DT FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D WHERE CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN #{FROM} AND #{TO} AND CLOSE_DT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY USE_DT, USE_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D (CARD_SQ, USE_DT, AMT, USE_CD, DETAIL, MERCHANT, TARGET_NM, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{CARD_SQ}, #{USE_DT}, #{AMT}, #{USE_CD}, NULLIF(#{DETAIL}, ''), NULLIF(#{MERCHANT}, ''), NULLIF(#{TARGET_NM}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D SET USE_DT = #{USE_DT}, AMT = #{AMT}, USE_CD = #{USE_CD}, DETAIL = NULLIF(#{DETAIL}, ''), MERCHANT = NULLIF(#{MERCHANT}, ''), TARGET_NM = NULLIF(#{TARGET_NM}, '') , UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE USE_SQ = #{USE_SQ} AND CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND CLOSE_DT IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D WHERE USE_SQ = #{USE_SQ} AND CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND CLOSE_DT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D SET USE_CD = #{USE_CD}, DETAIL = NULLIF(#{DETAIL}, ''), MERCHANT = NULLIF(#{MERCHANT}, ''), TARGET_NM = NULLIF(#{TARGET_NM}, ''), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE USE_SQ = #{USE_SQ} AND CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN #{FROM} AND #{TO} AND CLOSE_DT IS NULL

UPDATE TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D SET CLOSE_DT = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), CLOSE_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID} WHERE CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN #{FROM} AND #{TO} AND CLOSE_DT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D SET CLOSE_DT = NULL, CLOSE_EMPLY_ID = NULL WHERE CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN #{FROM} AND #{TO} AND CLOSE_DT IS NOT NULL
